description: This file defines several classes implementing the ITransformProcessor interface for MapReduce processing, including MapProcessor, ReduceProcessor, and EmptyProcessor, each with specific processing logic for string and dictionary data types.

classes.name: MapProcessor
classes.description: Processes input strings by splitting into tokens based on delimiters.

classes.name: ReduceProcessor
classes.description: Aggregates a list of strings into a dictionary counting occurrences, case-insensitive.

methods.name: Process
methods.description: Transforms input data into processed output based on class logic.
